description.value: JJ Bean Coffee Roasters is a Vancouver-born independent specialty coffee brand established in 1996, roasting high-quality single-origin and blended coffees in small batches daily across multiple Metro Vancouver cafés. The Cambie Street location is a full-service café offering all-day breakfast and lunch made fresh in-house alongside its renowned coffee program, with outdoor seating for customers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms JJ Bean is an active multi-location specialty coffee roaster with outdoor seating (corroborated by OSM outdoor_seating=yes) and all-day food service; OSM takeaway=yes is consistent with the counter-service café model shown on the website. The website contact page lists 604-254-0161 and 1904 Powell Street (roastery HQ), which differ from the Cambie location's OSM phone and address, so those fields cannot be confirmed for this specific café. Bike parking, water refill, and most optional amenities are not mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Phone mismatch: OSM lists +1 604 558 2262 for the Cambie location, but the website contact page shows 604-254-0161, which appears to be the roastery/HQ general line rather than the specific café.
Address mismatch: website contact page lists 1904 Powell Street (roastery HQ), not 3399 Cambie Street; the Cambie location address could not be independently confirmed from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: JJ Bean is an active, well-established specialty coffee café on Cambie Street with outdoor seating and fresh food — a practical and pleasant stop for touring cyclists. Phone discrepancy is a data quality issue, not a reason to exclude.

wow_evidence: Vancouver-born independent specialty coffee brand established in 1996... multiple Metro Vancouver cafés... outdoor seating
